title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
statement:
You are given a record of a single stock's price at the close of each trading day over some period. You may buy the stock on exactly one day and sell it on a later day, making at most one such transaction in total.

Your goal is to determine the maximum profit you could have earned from this one buy-then-sell transaction. You must buy before you sell (selling on the same day you buy is not allowed), and if no transaction can produce a positive profit, you should report that no profit was possible.

Write a function that examines the sequence of daily prices and returns the largest profit achievable under these rules.

examples.explanation: Buy on the day priced at 3 and sell on the following day priced at 9, giving a profit of 9 - 3 = 6. No other buy/sell pair yields a larger profit.
Prices strictly decrease every day, so any purchase followed by a later sale would result in a loss. The best choice is to make no transaction, earning a profit of 0.
